start_ray_cluster_head_and_workers: start a Ray cluster head node and worker nodes on SLURM using submitit with checkpointable gang scheduling
start_ray_cluster_head: start the Ray cluster head node on SLURM with configurable resource requirements and optional payload function
start_ray_cluster_workers: start an array of Ray worker nodes on SLURM that connect to an existing head node
shutdown_ray_cluster: cancel all SLURM jobs and clean up the rendezvous directory for a Ray cluster
find_free_port: find an available TCP port on the local machine with an optional preferred port to try first
